title: Extension of pointed etale neighbourhoods from the generic point
statement: Let $D$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], $K=k(D)$ and $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}K\to D$ its generic inclusion [def-sc-function-field]. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. For every pointed etale neighbourhood $(W,w)$ of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], there is a pointed etale neighbourhood $(V,v)$ of $s\circ\eta$ and a morphism of pointed etale neighbourhoods $(V\times_D\operatorname{Spec}K,(v,s))\to(W,w)$ over $\operatorname{Spec}K$.

source.place: Tags 02GH, 01ZM, 07RP; generic counit argument of blueprint lem-sc-affine-generic-second, proof paragraph 3

proof.text: Choose a nonempty affine open Spec A of D. Its fraction field is K. Spec K is the inverse limit of Spec A[1/a] over nonzero a: the ring colimit is the localization at all nonzero elements, namely K.

Restrict W to an affine neighbourhood W0 of the marked point. An affine etale scheme over a field is of finite presentation and qcqs. Apply object descent for etale finite-presentation data to the system Spec A[1/a] to obtain an etale finite-presentation scheme V0 over some A[1/a] and an isomorphism of its generic fibre with W0. In standard etale coordinates this is precisely clearing denominators in the finitely many presentation coefficients and in the inverse of the derivative.

Compose V0 -> Spec A[1/a] with the open immersion into D. Transport w through the generic-fibre isomorphism, then project to V0 to get v. This satisfies v composed with the structure map = s composed with eta. The fibre-product universal property identifies the base-changed marking (v,s) with the transported marking. Compose the generic-fibre isomorphism with W0 -> W to get the required pointed morphism. An empty W cannot have a marking from Spec Omega, so no empty case is lost.

proof_origin.place: Tags 02GH, 01ZM, 07RP; elementary specialization to the generic inclusion, and preimmersion equalization

    (D : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral D]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec D.functionField)

      (s ≫ D.fromSpecFunctionField) ⟨s, rfl⟩).obj c ⟶ d)
